inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Sikhala is warning that the proposed amendments are reportedly intended to extend Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. It looks like a power grab being pushed through constitutional procedure, with legal language used to make it seem legitimate. The missing details add to concern that the public may not see what is being arranged until it’s too late. The bill should be rejected before it is presented as a fait accompli.
